name: N D Metal Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, N.D. Metal Industries
Ltd imports, trades, and processes all kinds
of Ferrous and Non-Ferrous Metals and Alloys[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Ingots, Wire bar, Rods, Plates, 
Sheets,  Tubes, Pipes of Copper and Copper Alloys
b) Brass & Brass Alloys Ingots
c) Tin & Tin Alloys
d) Aluminum & Aluminum Alloys
e) Zinc & Zinc Alloys
f) Zinc Sulphate and Copper Sulphate
g) Copper/ Brass/ Zinc Ash
h) Master Alloys, Melting and Re-rolling 
of scrap/ waste/ dross/ residues of 
respective metals

cons: Stock is trading at 7.12 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -58.3% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.26% over last 3 years.
